Q13. The operating status of a system is being continuously monitored. When a new task is
applied to the system after several years of operation, which of the following is an
appropriate sequence of work items in capacity planning?
[Work items in capacity planning]
(i) Evaluate the proposed system configuration, assess its appropriateness, and conduct a
review if necessary.
(ii) Consider a proposal for the necessary system configuration based on system
characteristics, including factors such as the number of servers and whether parallel
distributed processing can be performed.
(iii) Understand the performance information of the hardware or environment inherent to
the system based on the operating status of the system.
(iv) Conduct a meeting with users to gather information about the new task, understand
requirements such as the estimated number of processes, and determine the time
required by the processes.

questions.promptText: Q23. Which of the following is an appropriate explanation of a log file in DBMS?

processing time of the database when the system goes down.
